warnings.text: Thales staking was shut down under TIP-238, and on 2026-06-01 the THALES in the reward escrow contract was moved out in a multisig transaction. Vesting fails until the team puts it back. There's no migration deadline: contact the Overtime team (discord.gg/thales) with your address.
If the escrow is refilled, this check turns Ready on its own and the steps below will work: vest your escrowed THALES, then migrate it to OVER 1:1.

verification.method: eth_simulateV1 vest+approve+migrate from holder at latest, traceTransfers, validation:false; repeated with a stateOverride giving the escrow THALES
verification.notes: EscrowThales proxy; iStakingThales() and StakingThales.iEscrowThales() point at each other. claimable(address) = totalAccountEscrowedAmount minus entries still inside the 10-period vesting window. Live: vest reverts 'SafeERC20: low-level call failed' because the escrow holds ~0 THALES (drain tx listed in sources upgraded the proxy and sent the full escrow balance to 0x1777C6d588fd931751762836811529c0073D6376). With a stateOverride of the escrow's THALES balance (block 157572003) the full path succeeds: vest pays 83985571441947488358 raw THALES, migrateThalesToOver pays the same raw amount of OVER. StakingThales still closes weekly periods, so unvested entries keep maturing into claimable(). Accounting total totalEscrowedRewards() = 190,767.9 THALES; drained 190,767.87 on 2026-06-01. OVER in migrator ~83.6k at check time, so a refilled escrow would still hit the migrator's payout limit.

verification.method: eth_simulateV1 withdraw+approve+mintWithOldKnc from holder at latest, traceTransfers, validation:false
verification.notes: KyberStaking (verified source, Etherscan label 'Kyber: Staking', kncToken() = legacy KNC). withdraw(uint256) has no lock or cooldown: it only needs stakerLatestData.stake >= amount and sends KNCL straight back. Then the existing KNCL→KNC mint (burn old, mint new 1:1, no reserve). ~712.6k KNCL staked across 1,487 addresses (contract holds 715.1k). Current KyberDAO docs list a newer KyberStaking (0xeadb96F1…) for KNC v2; this one is the legacy KNCL staking.

warnings.text: The vending machine converts in steps of 0.001 NU, so a tiny remainder may stay in your wallet.

verification.method: eth_simulateV1 withdraw+approve+wrap from holder at latest, traceTransfers, validation:false
verification.notes: StakingEscrow Dispatcher → impl StakingEscrow 0x939f82a1Aa8560E7a6Ef5Ae5C3752618fbA75698 (solc 0.8.23, verified). Current impl removed sub-stake locks: withdraw(uint256) only checks stakerInfo.value >= amount (onlyStaker), no lock/vesting check, also works for stakers linked to a T staking provider (simulated 1.5M NU for 0x04670e07…, OK). getAllTokens(address) = stakerInfo.value. 232 of 2,155 stakers still hold 27.30M NU. The other ~2.50B NU in the contract is the unminted reward reserve, not user stakes. Vending machine holds 629.3M T = 193.09M NU worth, which equals NU outside escrow+machine (165.8M) plus these stakes (27.3M): fully covered. Also simulated from the largest staker 0x7fff5512… (6.99M NU, a contract): OK.

verification.method: eth_simulateV1 withdraw+approve+migrate from holder at latest, traceTransfers, validation:false
verification.notes: veRBN VotingEscrow (Vyper) listed in Ribbon's deployed-contracts docs. locked(address) returns (int128 amount, uint256 end); word 0 is the RBN amount. withdraw() requires lock expired OR is_unlocked; is_unlocked() = true today and every one of the 203 remaining locks has expired anyway (latest end 2026-01-08), so withdraw works either way. 426,289.6 RBN still locked. Then the existing RBN→AEVO migrate (AevoStaking, ~67.7M AEVO reserve).
